headers['sign']=String(java.md5Encode(Object.keys(headers).sort().reduce((pre,n)=>pre+n+'='+headers[n],'')+sign_key))


var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);
  } else {
    for (var i in param) {
      var k = key == null ? i : key + (param instanceof Array ? '[' + i + ']' : '.' + i);
      paramStr += urlEncode(param[i], k, encode);
    }
  }
  return paramStr;
};

var category = function () {
  params={'gender':gender,'category_id':category_id,'need_filters':need_filters,'page':page,'need_category':need_category}

};

  params['sign']=String(java.md5Encode(Object.keys(params).sort().reduce((pre,n)=>pre+n+'='+params[n],'')+sign_key))
  url="https://api-bc.wtzw.com/api/v4/tag/index?"+urlEncode(params)
  return java.ajax(url+','+java.put("headers",JSON.stringify({"headers":headers})))
};

var urlEncode = function (param, key, encode) {
  if(param==null) return '';
  var paramStr = '';
  var t = typeof (param);
  if (t == 'string' || t == 'number' || t == 'boolean') {
    paramStr += '&' + key + '=' + ((encode==null||encode) ? encodeURIComponent(param) : param);
  } else {
    for (var i in param) {
      var k = key == null ? i : key + (param instanceof Array ? '[' + i + ']' : '.' + i);
      paramStr += urlEncode(param[i], k, encode);
    }
  }
  return paramStr;
};

ruleBookInfo.intro:
<js>
(function () {
    var g = function (r) {
        try { return String(java.getString(r) || '').trim(); } catch (e) { return ''; }
    };
    var uniq = function (v, i, a) { return v && a.indexOf(v) == i; };

    var words = parseInt(g('$.words_num')) || 0;
    var ws = words >= 10000 ? (words / 10000).toFixed(1) + '万字' : (words ? words + '字' : '');
    var chapters = g('$.chapters');
    var state = [ws, g('$.is_over') == '1' ? '已完结' : '连载中', chapters ? '共' + chapters + '章' : ''].filter(uniq).join(' · ');

    var ts = parseInt(g('$.update_time')) || 0;
    var time = ts ? String(java.timeFormat(ts * 1000)).replace(/\//g, '-') : '';

    var cat = [g('$.category1_name'), g('$.category2_name')].filter(uniq).join(' · ');
    var tags = g('$.book_tag_list[*].title').split(/\s*\n\s*/).filter(uniq).join(' · ');

    var score = g('$.attribute.score');
    var scoreT = g('$.attribute.score_title');
    var info = g('$.attribute.reading_info_list[*]').split(/\s*\n\s*/);
    var hot = [];
    if (info[0]) hot.push(info[0] + (info[1] ? '（' + info[1].split('・').pop() + '）' : ''));
    if (info[2]) hot.push(info[2] + '人在读');

    var desc = g('$.intro')
        .replace(/\r/g, '')
        .replace(/^[\s\u3000]+/, '')
        .replace(/[ \t\u3000]*\n[\s\u3000]*/g, '\n')
        .replace(/\n/g, '\n\u3000\u3000');

    var L = [];
    var add = function (icon, label, val) {
        if (val) L.push('\u3000\u3000' + icon + ' ' + label + '：' + val);
    };
    add('📕', '书名', g('$.title'));
    add('👤', '作者', g('$.author'));
    add('🗂️', '分类', cat);
    add('📊', '字数', state);
    add('🔖', '标签', tags);
    add('⭐', '评分', score ? score + (scoreT ? '（' + scoreT + '）' : '') : '');
    add('🔥', '人气', hot.join(' · '));
    add('🕐', '更新', time);
    add('📖', '最新', g('$.latest_chapter_title'));
    if (desc) {
        L.push('\u3000\u3000\u200b');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000📜 简介：');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000' + desc);
    }
    var src = g('$.source');
    if (src) {
        L.push('\u3000\u3000\u200b');
        L.push('\u3000\u3000📍 版权来源：' + src);
    }
    return L.join('\n');
})()
</js>

<js>var m = String(baseUrl).match(/\/books\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\.html/);
if (!m) {
    result = '章节地址解析失败: ' + baseUrl;
} else {
    var aid = m[1];
    var cid = m[2];
    var ua = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/126.0 Safari/537.36';
    var opt = ',{"headers":{"User-Agent":"' + ua + '","Referer":"' + baseUrl + '","X-Requested-With":"XMLHttpRequest"}}';
    var tokenJs = String(java.ajax('https://www.deqixs.cc/scripts/chapter.js.php?aid=' + aid + '&cid=' + cid + '&referrer=' + baseUrl + opt) || '');
    var t = tokenJs.match(/chapterToken\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/);
    var s = tokenJs.match(/timestamp\s*=\s*([0-9]+)/);
    var n = tokenJs.match(/nonce\s*=\s*'([^']+)'/);
    if (!t || !s || !n) {
        result = '获取token失败，请重试';
    } else {
        var apiUrl = 'https://www.deqixs.cc/modules/article/ajax2.php?aid=' + aid + '&cid=' + cid + '&token=' + t[1] + '&timestamp=' + s[1] + '&nonce=' + n[1] + opt;
        var res = String(java.ajax(apiUrl) || '');
        var json = null;
        try { json = JSON.parse(res); } catch (e) {}
        if (json && json.status == 1 && json.data && json.data.content) {
            result = json.data.content.replace(/<br\s*\/?>/gi, '\n').replace(/ /gi, ' ').replace(/更新不易[\s\S]*?(看最新章节|看最新无错章节|最新小说章节|请订阅)[！!]/g, '').replace(/速\s*读\s*谷|shudugu\.org/g, '').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();
        } else {
            result = '获取正文失败: ' + (json && json.message ? json.message : res.substring(0, 100));
        }
    }
}</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
let html = String(result);
let chars = "内暴强情缝肏插逼操潮喷阴艳裸乳荡穴鸡淫苞奸胸射嫩肉骚性蒂茎陰騷奶屄成人药春迷尿粉肛龟头A精屌口狂蜜处女唇道阳虐虫妇液色颜熟交爽臀爆舔做爱欲吹自慰点gG玉幼援抽Bb水母狗户部要了奴小脚痒酥死我兽揉搓捏扣抠棍棒洞密美少摩腿春乱伦露漏浪开巨根菊巴黑豪好肥送艳被干拔乱理白刺体下面诱感快货比日妈你娘婊子配仙火叫在里子宫给聊照流群屁眼马无码友拳洞片黄偷禁套弄位脱光舒服溜舞丢还糜妻换妓招嫖娼aA毛Hh一夜本热推图书娃男抓浑圆饱满润湿滑丰腴韵尤物横陈存娇喘息麻桃透风腹长粗肿胀人紧夹吸撅起来雪发翘硕大胴双草坐挲跨柔软臂瘫媚秘破";
var replacementChars = chars.split("");
replacementChars[43] = "AV";
html = html.replace(/<i class="icon icon-uni([0-9a-fA-F]{4})"><\/i>/g, (_, p1) =>
  String.fromCharCode(parseInt(p1, 16)));
const decoded = [];
for (let i = 0; i < html.length; i++) {
    let code = html.charCodeAt(i);
    if (code >= 0xE001 && code <= 0xE101) {
        decoded.push(replacementChars[code - 0xE001]);
    } else {
        decoded.push(html.charAt(i));
    }
}
html = decoded.join('');
const doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(html);
const contentDiv = doc.selectFirst('.content');
let lines = [];
if (contentDiv) {
    let ps = contentDiv.select('p');
    for (let i = 0; i < ps.size(); i++) {
        let t = String(ps.get(i).text()).replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim();
        if (t) lines.push(t);
    }
    let startIdx = -1;
    for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
        if (/^第\d+章|^序章|^楔子|^引子/.test(lines[i])) {
            startIdx = i;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (startIdx > 0) {
        lines = lines.slice(startIdx);
    } else if (startIdx === -1) {
        lines = lines.filter(l => 
          !/本书由.*?发行|版权所有|侵权必究|^\s*·\s*$/.test(l));
    }
}
lines.join('\n');
</js>

bookSourceComment:
可乐小说（rrssk.com搜索 + kelexs.com/nmxswz.com阅读）- 修复版v9.5

【修复内容】
1. 搜索作者：span.book-card__meta-item:first-child@textNodes##作者：## 精确提取
2. 搜索分类：span.book-card__meta-item:nth-of-type(2)@textNodes##分类：##
3. 发现规则：exploreUrl改为kelexs.com绝对路径，CSS选择器适配dList结构
4. 目录规则：双结构兼容，CSS逗号分组选择器 div.chapList ul li a, div.direList.chapter_list ul li a
5. 详情规则：全部使用meta标签（og:novel），两个站都支持
6. bookUrlPattern：同时匹配kelexs.com和nmxswz.com

【说明】
- 搜索通过rrssk.com的webJs签名机制进行，搜索结果为nmxswz.com链接
- 发现功能通过kelexs.com进行
- 两个站点的HTML结构不同，CSS逗号分组选择器自动适配

bookSourceComment:
网站的书都是用户上传，你也可去网站上传
【技术实现】
搜索：HTML 搜索（GET /search.php?q=）
发现：CSS 选择器（library.php 分页）
详情：CSS 选择器（详情页与目录同页）
目录：CSS 选择器（chapter-chip）
正文：CSS@html + JS 解码，反爬字符自动还原
登录：POST 表单登录（loginUi + loginUrl，Cookie 持久化）

【局限性】
- 网站有 GOEDGE WAF 防护，必须使用移动端 UA 请求头
- 章节以"段"为单位（TXT 分段），非传统章节
- 列表页作者字段实为上传者昵称
- 登录需在书源设置中配置邮箱和密码（切勿在公开群组分享含账号的书源）

<js>
// ===== 工具函数 =====
function absUrl(u){
  if(/^https?:/i.test(u)) return u;
  var m = String(baseUrl || '').match(/^(https?:\/\/[^\/]+)/);
  return (m ? m[1] : '') + u;
}
function numOf(u){
  var m = String(u).match(/-(\d+)(?:-\d+)?\.html$/);
  return m ? parseInt(m[1], 10) : 0;
}
function _p2(n){ return (n < 10 ? "0" : "") + n; }
function edgeHeaders(){
  var d = new Date();
  var t = String(d.getFullYear()).slice(2) + _p2(d.getMonth()+1) + _p2(d.getDate());
  return {
    "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/148.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/148.0.0.0",
    "X-Requested-With": "cn.mujiankeji.mbrowser",
    "Cookie": "k=" + t + ";",
    "Upgrade-Insecure-Requests": "1",
    "Accept": "text/html,application/xhtml+xml,application/xml;q=0.9,image/avif,image/webp,image/apng,*/*;q=0.8,application/signed-exchange;v=b3;q=0.7",
    "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded"
  };
}
function encBody(text, sk, iv){
  try {
    return java.createSymmetricCrypto("aes/cbc/pkcs7padding", java.strToBytes(sk), java.strToBytes(iv)).encryptBase64(text);
  } catch(e) {}
  try {
    var key = Packages.javax.crypto.spec.SecretKeySpec(java.strToBytes(sk), "AES");
    var ivi = Packages.javax.crypto.spec.IvParameterSpec(java.strToBytes(iv));
    var ci = Packages.javax.crypto.Cipher.getInstance("AES/CBC/PKCS5Padding");
    ci.init(Packages.javax.crypto.Cipher.ENCRYPT_MODE, key, ivi);
    return Packages.java.util.Base64.getEncoder().encodeToString(ci.doFinal(java.strToBytes(text)));
  } catch(e) { return ""; }
}
function ajaxPost(url, body){
  // 与参考版一致：普通 java.ajax，不加特殊请求头（手机UA即可，被WAF拦会自动回退）
  try {
    return String(java.ajax(url + ',' + JSON.stringify({method: 'POST', body: body})) || '');
  } catch(e) { return ''; }
}

// ===== 第1页章节：兼容 人人书城/爱书库(chapListBody) 与 书友社(chapterList) =====
var hrefs = [], names = [];
try { hrefs = java.getStringList('class.chapListBody@li@a@href') || []; } catch(e) {}
try { names = java.getStringList('class.chapListBody@li@a@text') || []; } catch(e) {}
if(hrefs.length === 0){
  try { hrefs = java.getStringList('class.chapterList@class.list@li@div.name@a@href') || []; } catch(e) {}
  try { names = java.getStringList('class.chapterList@class.list@li@div.name@a@text') || []; } catch(e) {}
}
var out = [];
for(var i = 0; i < hrefs.length; i++){
  var u = absUrl(hrefs[i]);
  out.push({name: names[i] || '', url: u, order: numOf(u)});
}

// ===== 解析 id / 分页数 / AES密钥 =====
var id = '';
try {
  var mid = String(baseUrl || '').match(/\/(?:chapter|book)\/([^\/.?]+?)(?:-\d+)?\.html/);
  if(mid) id = mid[1];
} catch(e) {}
var pageCount = 0;
try {
  var opts = java.getElements('[data-aid="' + id + '"]@option') || [];
  if(opts.length === 0) opts = java.getElements('[data-aid="' + id + '"]@li') || [];
  pageCount = opts.length;
} catch(e) {}
var secretKey = '', ivKey = '';
try {
  var src = String(result || '');
  var mjs = src.match(/<script[^>]*src="([^"]*\/([A-Za-z0-9]{32,})\.js)"[^>]*>/);
  if(mjs){
    var jsTxt = String(java.ajax(absUrl(mjs[1])) || '');
    var mk = jsTxt.match(/AESCrypt\('([^']+)'\)/);
    var mik = jsTxt.match(/parse\('([^']+)'\)/);
    if(mk) secretKey = mk[1];
    if(mik) ivKey = mik[1];
  }
} catch(e) {}

// ===== 拉取其余页（java.post + Edge头） =====
var fetched = false;
if(id && pageCount > 1 && secretKey && ivKey){
  try {
    var baseHost = String(baseUrl || '').match(/^(https?:\/\/[^\/]+)/);
    baseHost = baseHost ? baseHost[1] : '';
    for(var p = 2; p <= pageCount; p++){
      try {
        var body = JSON.stringify({id: id, page: p});
        var enc = encBody(body, secretKey, ivKey);
        if(!enc) break;
        var resp = ajaxPost(baseHost + '/index.php?action=loadChapterPage', 'data=' + encodeURIComponent(enc));
        var obj = JSON.parse(resp);
        if(obj && obj.code === 0 && obj.data && obj.data.length){
          for(var j = 0; j < obj.data.length; j++){
            var it = obj.data[j];
            var u2 = absUrl(it.chapterurl || '');
            out.push({name: it.chaptername || '', url: u2, order: parseInt(it.chapterorder, 10) || numOf(u2) || 0});
          }
          fetched = true;
        } else { break; }
      } catch(e) { break; }
      try { Packages.java.lang.Thread.sleep(800 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 500)); } catch(e) {}
    }
  } catch(e) {}
}

// ===== 去重 + 升序 =====
var seen = {}, list = [];
for(var i = 0; i < out.length; i++){
  var k = out[i].order || out[i].url;
  if(seen[k]) continue;
  seen[k] = 1;
  list.push(out[i]);
}
list.sort(function(a, b){ return (a.order || 0) - (b.order || 0); });

// ===== 分页失败：用总章数占位补齐（不重复） =====
if(!fetched && id && list.length > 0){
  try {
    var bu = (typeof book !== 'undefined' && book && book.bookUrl) ? book.bookUrl : absUrl('/book/' + id + '.html');
    var detail = String(java.ajax(bu) || '');
    var mt = detail.match(/og:novel:latest_chapter_name"\s+content="第(\d+)章/);
    if(!mt) mt = detail.match(/\((\d+)章节\)/);
    var total = mt ? parseInt(mt[1], 10) : 0;
    var have = {};
    for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){ have[list[i].order] = 1; }
    for(var n = 1; n <= total; n++){
      if(!have[n]){
        list.push({name: '第' + n + '章', url: absUrl('/book/' + id + '-' + n + '.html'), order: n});
      }
    }
    list.sort(function(a, b){ return (a.order || 0) - (b.order || 0); });
  } catch(e) {}
}

var res = [];
for(var i = 0; i < list.length; i++){
  res.push(JSON.stringify({name: list[i].name, url: list[i].url, order: list[i].order}));
}
if(res.length === 0 && id){
  res.push(JSON.stringify({name: '第1章', url: absUrl('/book/' + id + '-1.html'), order: 1}));
}
res;
</js>

bookSourceComment:
五八书阁（m.5859ycdh.com）
免费小说阅读网站，无需登录，无搜索次数限制。
【技术实现】
搜索：POST /search/（body: q={{key}}），不支持分页
发现：分类目录（/wuba131/~139/）+ 书库 + 排行榜 + 完本
  - 分类/书库/排行榜支持 ?page={{page}} 分页
  - 完本不支持分页（固定100本）
详情：/wuba/{bookId}/ CSS 选择器
目录：/wuba/{bookId}/list.html（全量章节，无分页）
正文：/wubashu/{bookId}/{chapterId}.html（章节内分页，#PageSet）
【URL 规律】
书籍详情：/wuba/{bookId}/
章节目录：/wuba/{bookId}/list.html
正文页面：/wubashu/{bookId}/{chapterId}.html
正文分页：{chapterId}-{pageNum}.html
【规则语法说明】
- 详情页：用 Default规则语法(class.B@tag.dd.1@...) 和 CSS类选择器(span.ml, span.c)
- 发现/搜索页：用 Default规则语法(tag.dd.1@...)，因为CSS选择器不支持数字索引
- 发现页 dl.B（大卡片）和 dl.S（小卡片）共存，bookList 用逗号合并
- 部分页面图片使用 data-src 懒加载，已用 || 兼容
- 正文末尾有广告文本，已用正则清理
- 正文有内分页，已配置 nextContentUrl
- 编码：UTF-8

bookSourceComment: 纸间 zjread.cc 书源 v21。搜索/详情/目录/正文全部在规则内完成（AES-256-GCM + HKDF + HMAC 自实现）。正文章节密钥派生已逆向，规则内本地解密。简繁转换采用 OpenCC tw→cn 方案（与站点“简繁”按钮同系；本地按官方 OpenCC master 词典实现，并修正 著/着 等易错词与个别缺字）。站点人机验证为 Altcha（工作量证明/图片验证码，含 PBKDF2 变体）或 Cloudflare Turnstile：Altcha 全自动完成（PBKDF2 借助后台 WebView 原生计算），Turnstile 会弹验证页需点一下；同一会话内验证结果在搜索/正文间共用（避免整本下载反复求解），有效期约 10 分钟，到期自动重验。说明：① 连载书最新章节前若干章可能“暂不可阅读”，会提示；② 目录接口偶发较慢（上游抓取），首次打开新书可能稍慢，之后会缓存；③ 封面接口需鉴权（401），故不显示封面；④ 从旧版本升级的**已有书籍**，请对书架里的书执行一次“更新书籍信息”（或重新添加），以刷新目录地址；⑤ 本源的接口加密/正文本地解密/PBKDF2 验证依赖完整 Java 环境，请使用安卓版 Legado（官方/Beta、MD3、Sigma、MAX、阅读C 等 Rhino 内核分支），鸿蒙/Flutter/桌面重写版暂不支持。

        if (t && !/温馨提示|本章.*完.*继续阅读|wjzxchina/.test(t)) {
            lines.push(t);
        }
    }
    if (lines.length === 0) {
        var text = String(content.text()).replace(/\u00a0/g, ' ').trim();
        if (text) lines.push(text);
    }
}
lines.join('\n');
</js>

<js>
var host = "http://cn.kukuc.cc";

// ============ 模式状态 ============
var MODES = ["🔥 更新与排行", "📚 书库"];
var currentMode = "🔥 更新与排行";
try {
  var saved = source.getVariable();
  if (saved) {
    var obj = JSON.parse(saved);
    if (obj.mode && MODES.indexOf(obj.mode) >= 0) currentMode = obj.mode;
  }
} catch (e) {}

// ============ 书库：地区状态 ============
var channels = {
  "🌏 全部": "9",
  "🇯🇵 日漫": "1",
  "🌏 港台": "2",
  "🇺🇸 美漫": "3",
  "🇨🇳 国漫": "4",
  "🇰🇷 韩漫": "5",
  "❓ 未分类": "6"
};
var currentChannel = "🌏 全部";
try {
  var saved2 = source.getVariable();
  if (saved2) {
    var obj2 = JSON.parse(saved2);
    if (obj2.channel && channels[obj2.channel]) currentChannel = obj2.channel;
  }
} catch (e) {}
var area = channels[currentChannel] || "9";

// ============ 数据 ============
var tags = ["全部","长条","大女主","韩漫","奇幻","轻小说","生活","悬疑","格斗","搞笑","竞技","职场","萌系","冒险","治愈","都市","霸总","神鬼","侦探","爱情","古风","科幻","穿越","校园","美食","热血","励志","异世界","历史","战争","恐怖","后宫","系统","耽美","纯爱","玄幻","爆笑","修真","魔幻","装逼","逆袭","复仇","日常","青春","亲情","宅斗"];
var fulls = [["全部","3"],["连载中","4"],["已完结","1"]];
var ranks = [["🔥 总点击榜","alldj"],["📈 月点击榜","ydj"],["📊 周点击榜","zdj"],["📉 日点击榜","rdj"],["⭐ 总收藏榜","allfav"]];
var weekdays = ["周一","周二","周三","周四","周五","周六","周日"];

// ============ UI 骨架 ============
var ui = [
  { title: '关键字', type: 'text', default: '', style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1 } },
  { title: '🔍 搜索本站', type: 'button', action: "var k=infoMap['关键字']; if(!k){ java.toast('请输入漫画名称'); } else { java.searchBook(k, source); }", style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1 } },
  { title: '模式切换', type: 'select', chars: MODES, default: currentMode, action: "var m=infoMap['模式切换']; var obj={}; try{obj=JSON.parse(source.getVariable());}catch(e){} obj.mode=m; source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(obj)); java.refreshExplore();", style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1 } }
];

// 一行一个（整行按钮）
function pushRow(name, urlStr) {
  ui.push({ title: name, url: urlStr, style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 1 } });
}
// 一行多个（小按钮）
function pushCell(name, urlStr) {
  ui.push({ title: name, url: urlStr, style: { layout_flexGrow: 1, layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.2 } });
}

// ============ 模式 1：更新与排行 ============
if (currentMode === "🔥 更新与排行") {

  ui.push({ title: '━━━ 【排行榜】 ━━━', url: '', style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1, layout_flexGrow: 1 } });
  ranks.forEach(function(r) {
    pushRow(r[0], host + '/kukuctop/' + r[1] + '.html');
  });

  ui.push({ title: '━━━ 【每日更新】 ━━━', url: '', style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1, layout_flexGrow: 1 } });
  weekdays.forEach(function(d, idx) {
    pushCell("🆕 " + d, host + '/kukucupdate/' + (idx + 1) + '.html');
  });

}

// ============ 模式 2：书库 ============
if (currentMode === "📚 书库") {

  ui.push({ title: '书库地区', type: 'select', chars: Object.keys(channels), default: currentChannel, action: "var c=infoMap['书库地区']; var obj={}; try{obj=JSON.parse(source.getVariable());}catch(e){} obj.channel=c; source.setVariable(JSON.stringify(obj)); java.refreshExplore(); java.toast('已切换到: '+c);", style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1 } });

  ui.push({ title: '━━━ 【按类型】 ━━━', url: '', style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1, layout_flexGrow: 1 } });
  tags.forEach(function(t) {
    pushCell(t, host + '/kukucmangalists/' + area + '/' + encodeURIComponent(t) + '/3/{{page}}.html');
  });

  ui.push({ title: '━━━ 【按进度】 ━━━', url: '', style: { layout_flexBasisPercent: 1, layout_flexGrow: 1 } });
  fulls.forEach(function(f) {
    pushCell("📖 " + f[0], host + '/kukucmangalists/' + area + '/全部/' + f[1] + '/{{page}}.html');
  });

}

JSON.stringify(ui);
</js>

var res = JSON.parse(result);
var bookList = [];
var tabs = res && res.search_tabs ? res.search_tabs : [];
function isArray(value) {
  return Object.prototype.toString.call(value) === '[object Array]';
}
for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) {
  var tab = tabs[i];
  if (!tab || String(tab.tab_type) !== '8' || !isArray(tab.data)) continue;
  for (var j = 0; j < tab.data.length; j++) {
    var item = tab.data[j];
    if (item && isArray(item.book_data)) {
      for (var k = 0; k < item.book_data.length; k++) {
        if (item.book_data[k]) bookList.push(item.book_data[k]);
      }
    } else if (item && item.book_data) {
      bookList.push(item.book_data);
    } else if (item && item.book_id) {
      bookList.push(item);
    }
  }
}
JSON.stringify(bookList)
</js>$[*]

搜索分类
@用户
%视频
#专栏
&直播
*番剧
？影视

API来源
https://github.com/SocialSisterYi/bilibili-API-collect

url scheme链接来源
AI和网页

⚙️部分功能说明【自己随便点点点看看吧】
登录使用效果更佳

点击评论数量条左边进入 评论主题管理

1、详情页界面 
点击书名显示【最新评论】
长按书名显示【热门评论】

点击UP主名字显示 【视频列表/专栏文集】【根据登录页设置来】
长按UP主名字显示 【视频合集/专栏动态】【根据登录页设置来】

点击 查看全部动态【查看动态】
长按 查看全部动态【搜索该up主动态】

点击右上角◎ 打开哔哩哔哩客户端
点击分享按钮，复制分享详情
点击拷贝书籍详情URL  复制网页链接
点击登录 可选择【关注up到b站 [需登录账号]】

2、视频页
点击右上角◎ 打开推荐视频 【影视无效，直播无效】
点击登录 可点赞投币收藏

3、发现页
长按书源选项后打开登录页面，可筛选分类

4、正文页
视频/文章图可点击跳转
🔗📖🎥👤图标可点击跳转

5、登录页
可选择是否上传历史记录

try{
let all = [];
let 展开符 = "↓ ";
let 收起符 = "↑ ";
let 占位符 = "※"
let 启用占位 = true   //是：true,否：false
//一行个数
let numy = 3;

let d = {
    1: 1,
    2: 0.4,
    3: 0.25,
    4: 0.2,
    5: 0.15,
    7: 0.1,
    10: 0.05
};

let num = d[numy];
let push = (title, url, num, g,action) =>{
	let j = {
    title: title,
    url: url,
    style: {
        layout_flexGrow: g == 0 ? g : 1,
        layout_flexBasisPercent: num
    }
  }
     if(action){
         j.action = action.action;
         j.name = action.name;
         j.type = action.type;
         j.chars = action.chars;
         j.viewName = action.viewName;
         j.default = action.default;      
     }     
     all.push(j)	
} 

function zwf(len,numy,num){
	if(len%numy!==0){
        let n = len % numy;
        let p = numy-n;
      
        for(let i=0;i<p;i++){
            push(占位符, ``, num, 1,{"type":"button","action":"java.toast('这是占位符')"});
        }
    }
}
let navdata = java.ajax("https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/nav")
let mid = JSON.parse(navdata)?.data?.mid || "";
let searchOrder = changeSearch();

push("搜索类型", "", searchOrder.length?0.4:1,1,{
        "type": "select",
        "action":"show(infoMap['搜索类型'],'searchselect');changeSearch()",
        "chars":["🏷综合","👤用户","🎥视频","📖专栏","🎞影视","📽番剧","📺直播"],
        "default": Map("searchselect")||"综合"
    });
    
    
    if(searchOrder.length){
    push("搜索排序", "", 0.4,1,{
        "type": "select",
        "action":"show(infoMap['搜索排序'],'searchorder')",
        "chars":searchOrder,
        "default": Map("searchorder")||"综合排序"
    });
    }
    push("搜索关键词", "",d["2"],1,{
        "type": "text",
        "viewName":"'搜索关键词： '+Map('searchk')",
        "action":"show(infoMap['搜索关键词'],'searchk',1)",
        "default":Map("searchk")
    });
    push("🔍搜索", "", d["5"],1,{
    	    "action":"toSearch()",   
        "type": "button"       
    });
push("👤我的", "", 1);
push("推送视频", "https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/index/top/feed/rcmd", num);
push("热门视频", "https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/popular?pn={\{page}}", num);
push("入站必刷", "https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/popular/precious", num);

if (mid) {
    push("正在直播", "https://api.live.bilibili.com/xlive/web-ucenter/v1/xfetter/GetWebList?hit_ab=true", num);

    push("专栏动态", `https://api.bilibili.com/x/polymer/web-dynamic/v1/feed/all?timezone_offset=-480&type=article&platform=web&offset={\{if(page==1){source.put("nextoffset","")};source.get("nextoffset")}}&page={\{page}}`, num);
    push("视频动态", `https://api.bilibili.com/x/polymer/web-dynamic/v1/feed/all?timezone_offset=-480&type=video&platform=web&offset={\{if(page==1){source.put("dnextoffset","")};source.get("dnextoffset")}}&page={\{page}}`, num);
    push("历史记录", `https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/history/cursor?max={\{if(page==1){source.put("nextoffset","")};source.get("nextoffset")}}`, num);
    if(启用占位){
    push(占位符, ``, num, 1,{"type":"button","action":"java.toast('这是占位符')"});
    push(占位符, ``, num, 1,{"type":"button","action":"java.toast('这是占位符')"});
    }
push("⚙️关注分组", "", 1,1,{
        "action":"show(infoMap['⚙️关注分组'],'follows')",        
        "type": "toggle",
        "chars": [展开符, 收起符],
        "default": Map("follows")||展开符
});

if(isShow('follows',展开符)){
        push("全部", "https://api.bilibili.com/x/relation/followings?vmid="+mid+"&pn={\{page}}",num);
        关注分组url = "https://api.bilibili.com/x/relation/tags";
        关注分组data = JSON.parse(java.ajax(关注分组url));
        (关注分组data?.data ?? []).forEach(x => {
            push(x.name, `https://api.bilibili.com/x/relation/tag?pn={{page}\}&tagid=${x.tagid}`, num)
        })
        
        启用占位?zwf((关注分组data?.data ?? []).length+1,numy,num):null
    }

push("🗂收藏夹", "", 1,1,{
        "action":"show(infoMap['🗂收藏夹'],'favse')",        
        "type": "toggle",
        "chars": [展开符, 收起符],
        "default": Map("favse")||展开符
});
if(isShow('favse',展开符)){
        收藏夹url = "https://api.bilibili.com/x/v3/fav/folder/created/list-all?up_mid=" + mid;
        收藏夹data = JSON.parse(java.ajax(收藏夹url));
        (收藏夹data?.data?.list ?? []).forEach(x => {
            push(x.title, `https://api.bilibili.com/x/v3/fav/resource/list?media_id=${x.id}&ps=20&pn={\{page}}`, num)
        })
        
        启用占位?zwf((收藏夹data?.data?.list ?? []).length,numy,num):null
    }
}

push("📽视频分区", "", 1,1,{

if(isShow('videofq',展开符)){
分区.forEach(x => {

    push(a[0], `https://api.bilibili.com/x/web-interface/region/feed/rcmd?{\{getWbiEnc(${json})}}`, num)

启用占位?zwf(分区.length,numy,num):null

try {
    // 抛弃正则，直接用字符串分割，完美避开嵌套大括号被截断的问题
    var parts = String(result).split('var player_aaaa=');
    if (parts.length > 1) {
        // 截取到 </script> 之前的内容
        var jsonStr = parts[1].split('</script>')[0].trim();
        // 如果末尾有分号，则去掉分号，确保是纯净的 JSON
        if (jsonStr.charAt(jsonStr.length - 1) === ';') {
            jsonStr = jsonStr.slice(0, -1);
        }
        
        var data = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
        var url = String(data.url);
        
        if (data.encrypt == 2) {
            var b64Str = String(java.base64Decode(url));
            url = decodeURIComponent(b64Str);
        } else if (data.encrypt == 1) {
            url = decodeURIComponent(url);
        }
        
        out = '' + url.replace(/\\\//g, '/');
    } else {
        out = '⚠️ 解析失败，源码中未找到 player_aaaa 配置。';
    }
} catch(e) {
    out = '⚠️ 解析异常：' + String(e);
}
out;

for (let i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {

<js>
(function(){
    var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result, baseUrl);
    function trim(s){ return s ? String(s).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, "") : ""; }
    function text(el){ return el ? trim(el.text()) : ""; }
    function absHref(el){ return el ? trim(el.attr("abs:href")) : ""; }
    function norm(s){ return trim(String(s || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ")); }
    function forumIdFromUrl(u){ var m = String(u || "").match(/[?&]fid=(\d+)/); return m ? m[1] : ""; }
    function forumNameFromId(fid){ if (fid == "30") return "中文百合漫画区"; if (fid == "49") return "文学区"; if (fid == "55") return "轻小说/译文区"; return ""; }
    function cleanForumName(s){ return norm(s).replace(/^#/, "").replace(/文學區/g, "文学区"); }
    function makeBookUrl(threadUrl, uid){ var m = String(threadUrl || "").match(/[?&]tid=(\d+)/); if (m && uid) return "https://bbs.yamibo.com/forum.php?mod=viewthread&tid=" + m[1] + "&page=1&authorid=" + uid + "&mobile=2"; return trim(threadUrl || ""); }
    function shouldKeep(title, desc, forumId, label, icon){
        if (!title) return false;
        if (icon && icon.indexOf("投票") >= 0) return false;
        if (!/^(30|49|55)$/.test(String(forumId || ""))) return false;
        if (/版规|版規|目录编辑教程|目錄編輯教程|新人须知|新人須知|如何找回账号|如何修改密码|禁止转载|禁止轉載|求助|報到|签到|簽到|公告/.test(title)) return false;
        var hay = [title, desc, label].join(" ");
        var kw = /(翻译|翻譯|渣翻|自翻|渣译|渣譯|转载|轉載|生肉|更新|话|話|章|长篇|長篇|短篇|中篇|译介|譯介|文库|文庫|完结|完結|汉化组|漢化組|汉化|漢化|第.{0,10}[话話章]|[0-9一二三四五六七八九十百零〇]+[话話章])/i;
        return kw.test(hay);
    }
    var list = [];
    var items = doc.select('.threadlist li.list');
    for (var i = 0; i < items.size(); i++) {
        var li = items.get(i);
        var title = norm(text(li.select('.threadlist_tit').first()));
        var poster = text(li.select('.muser a.mmc').first());
        var uidHref = absHref(li.select('.muser a.mmc').first());
        var uidM = uidHref.match(/[?&]uid=(\d+)/);
        var uid = uidM ? uidM[1] : '';
        var desc = norm(text(li.select('.threadlist_mes').first()));
        var labelEl = li.select('.threadlist_foot li.mr a').first();
        var label = cleanForumName(text(labelEl));
        var forumHref = absHref(labelEl);
        var forumId = forumIdFromUrl(forumHref) || forumIdFromUrl(baseUrl);
        var forumName = forumNameFromId(forumId) || label;
        var icon = norm(text(li.select('.threadlist_tit .micon, .threadlist_tit em').first())).replace(/[\[\]]/g, '');
        if (!shouldKeep(title, desc, forumId, label, icon)) continue;
        var threadUrl = absHref(li.select("a[href*='viewthread']").first());
        var bookUrl = makeBookUrl(threadUrl, uid);
        var kind = '百合会' + (forumName ? ',' + forumName : '') + (icon ? ',' + icon : '');
        var intro = (forumName ? ('[' + forumName + '] ') : '') + desc;
        list.push({name:title, author: trim(poster || ''), kind:kind, word:'', last:text(li.select('.mtime').first()), intro:intro, cover:'', url:bookUrl});
    }
    return list;
})();
</js>

<js>
(function(){
    var doc = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(result, baseUrl);
    function trim(s){ return s ? String(s).replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') : ''; }
    function norm(s){ return trim(String(s || '').replace(/\u00A0/g, ' ').replace(/[ \t\r\f\v]+/g, ' ')); }
    function decodeTextLines(s){
        s = String(s || '').replace(/\r/g, '');
        var arr = s.split('\n');
        for (var i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) arr[i] = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(arr[i]).text();
        return arr.join('\n');
    }
    function messageToText(msgEl){
        if (!msgEl) return '';
        var c = msgEl.clone();
        c.select('i.pstatus, script, style, rt, .quote, .pstatus, .aimg_tip, .jammer').remove();
        var rubies = c.select('ruby');
        for (var i = rubies.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) rubies.get(i).unwrap();
        var as = c.select('a');
        for (var j = as.size() - 1; j >= 0; j--) as.get(j).unwrap();
        var h = String(c.html() || '');
        h = h.replace(/<br[^>]*>/ig, '\n');
        h = h.replace(/<hr[^>]*>/ig, '\n\n');
        h = h.replace(/<li[^>]*>/ig, '\n');
        h = h.replace(/<\/(?:li|div|p|section|blockquote|article|header|footer|aside|tr|td|th|ul|ol|table|tbody|thead|tfoot)>/ig, '\n');
        h = h.replace(/<h[1-6][^>]*>/ig, '\n\n');
        h = h.replace(/<\/h[1-6]>/ig, '\n\n');
        h = h.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, '');
        h = decodeTextLines(h);
        h = h.replace(/\u00A0/g, ' ');
        h = h.replace(/[ \t\f\v]+/g, ' ');
        h = h.replace(/ *\n */g, '\n');
        h = h.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
        return trim(h);
    }
    function linesFromMessage(msgEl){
        var txt = messageToText(msgEl);
        var raw = txt.split(/\n+/);
        var arr = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < raw.length; i++) {
            var line = norm(raw[i]);
            if (!line) continue;
            if (/^(本帖最后由|評分|评分|點評|点评|參與人數|参与人数|積分|积分|理由|查看全部评分)/.test(line)) continue;
            arr.push(line);
        }
        return arr;
    }
    function cleanThreadTitle(){
        var t = trim(doc.select('.view_tit').first().text());
        t = t.replace(/^\s*(?:[\[【][^\]】]{1,20}[\]】]\s*)+/g, '');
        t = t.replace(/[\[【](?:\d+[.\-/]\d+更新.*?|更新.*?|完结.*?|完結.*?)[\]】]\s*$/g, '');
        t = t.replace(/\s+\d+\s*\/\s*\d+\s*(?:\(\d+\s*\/\s*\d+\))?\s*$/g, '');
        return trim(t);
    }
    function firstMeaningful(lines, rawTitle, imgCount){
        if (imgCount >= 2) return rawTitle;
        for (var i = 0; i < lines.length && i < 16; i++) {
            var line = lines[i];
            if (/^(作品名稱|作品名称|作品名|書名|书名|標題|标题|題名|题名|原名|作者\s*[:：]?|原作\s*[:：]?|原著\s*[:：]?|翻譯\s*[:：]?|翻译\s*[:：]?|譯者\s*[:：]?|译者\s*[:：]?|校對\s*[:：]?|校对\s*[:：]?|圖源\s*[:：]?|图源\s*[:：]?|嵌字\s*[:：]?|漢化\s*[:：]?|汉化\s*[:：]?|簡介\s*[:：]?|简介\s*[:：]?|內容簡介\s*[:：]?|内容简介\s*[:：]?|原文简介\s*[:：]?|作品連結\s*[:：]?|作品链接\s*[:：]?|連結\s*[:：]?|链接\s*[:：]?|原地址\s*[:：]?|生肉\s*[:：]?|作品標籤\s*[:：]?|作品标签\s*[:：]?|主題\s*[:：]?|主题\s*[:：]?|目錄|目录|邊看邊翻|边看边翻|嚴禁劇透|严禁剧透)/.test(line)) continue;
            if (/^[0-9]{1,3}(后)?$/.test(line)) continue;
            if (line.length <= 1) continue;
            return line;
        }
        return rawTitle;
    }
    function isIntroCatalogPost(index, lines, msg){
        if (index != 0) return false;
        var tocLinks = msg.select("a[href*='goto=findpost'], a[href*='pid=']").size();
        if (tocLinks >= 2) return true;
        var joined = lines.join('\n');
        if (/(作品名稱|作品名称|作品名|書名|书名|作者|原作|原著|簡介|简介)/.test(joined) && /(目錄|目录|索引)/.test(joined)) return true;
        return false;
    }
    function isChapter(name, text, imgCount){
        if (imgCount >= 2) return true;
        if (/^(前言|序章|后记|後記|番外|楔子|序|终章|終章|尾声|尾聲|最終話|最终话|第.{0,16}[话話章节章卷篇回]|[一二三四五六七八九十百零〇0-9]+[话話章节章卷篇回])/.test(name)) return true;
        if (text.length >= 180) return true;
        return false;
    }

    var list = [];
    var posts = doc.select('.plc.cl');
    var pageUrl = String(baseUrl || '').replace(/([?&])__pid=\d+/g, '$1').replace(/&&+/g, '&').replace(/#pid\d+$/g, '');
    var rawTitle = cleanThreadTitle();
    for (var i = 0; i < posts.size(); i++) {
        var post = posts.get(i);
        var pid = String(post.id() || '').replace(/^pid/, '');
        var msg = post.select('.message').first();
        if (!pid || !msg) continue;
        var lines = linesFromMessage(msg);
        if (isIntroCatalogPost(i, lines, msg)) continue;
        var text = lines.join('\n');
        var imgCount = msg.select('img').size();
        var name = firstMeaningful(lines, rawTitle, imgCount);
        if (!isChapter(name, text, imgCount)) continue;
        var url = pageUrl + (pageUrl.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + '__pid=' + pid + '#pid' + pid;
        list.push({name: name || rawTitle, url: url});
    }
    return list;
})();

直：不做目录识别，直接将详情页作为目录页，或以“[目录链接]”格式直接指定目录链接，目录识别错误时可这种做。
跳：允许目录自动跳转，目录标题说点击跳转时可如此做。
全：直接显示“预览正文”和查询到的所有章节，跳过章节筛选环节，单页文章和部分筛选后章节不全的小说网站可这样做。
逆：设置目录章节逆向排序。
原：设置书籍不进行净化替换，优点是加载正文快速且不会被误删内容，缺点是需要自己写“替换净化”规则并在正文中启用才能净化网站推广文本。
动：强制设置正文动态加载(正文默认会进行需要动态加载还是静态加载的判断，然后自动切换模式，若判断失误导致本应切换成动态加载却未切换时，可强制设置正文动态加载)。
静：强制设置正文静态加载(正文默认会进行需要动态加载还是静态加载的判断，然后自动切换模式，若判断失误导致本应保持静态加载却切换成动态加载而使正文加载时间变长时，可强制设置正文静态加载)。
图：设置成看图模式(默认为图文模式)，只显示图片，不显示文字。
字：设置成纯字模式(默认为图文模式)，只显示文本，不显示图片。
─────⤴
──目录有分页却无翻页按钮或书籍无目录──
单：无目录打开即正文但有尾页或下一页按钮的书籍，必须设置为单向模式，这样书源会直接将入口页作为正文第一页，并将第一页及其所有下一页共同构造生成“正文1”、“正文2”…的目录形式来阅读，搜索前缀“单^”、书籍变量“单”、添加网址“?单”。
录：有目录分页但无目录下一页按钮的书籍，可在书籍变量中直接指定复制到的最后目录页链接为目录链接并添加指令“录”，即可自动生成所有目录分页。
书籍变量：“[https://m.zuizaoxiaoshuo.com/ml/33280_13]录”
还可复制最后那个目录页链接并在其后加“?录”进行“添加网址”，从而自动生成补全所有目录分页。
示范链接：“https://m.zuizaoxiaoshuo.com/ml/33280_13/?录”
辅助生成──无目录打开即正文也无尾页和下一页按钮的书籍，需指定章节数量并用第二页链接作为参考链接生成所有分页。
书籍变量──220#https://wap.yqshuwang.com/2021n/02/14972_2.html#
效果说明──根据第二页链接“https://wap.yqshuwang.com/2021n/02/14972_2.html”生成220条章节的目录列表。
单个章节──目录仅一个章节且这个章节正文中无下一页按钮时，可复制那个章节的正文尾页链接并用指令“单”，便可将所有正文分页构造成章节列表。
书籍变量──[http://www.yulinzhanye.la/20/20733/532447_9.html]单
───────功能补充────────
在导入的书籍链接后加“?”，然后跟着“单直跳全逆原图字动静”中任意多个字或“[目录url]”或“[正文尾页url]单”或“数字#第二页链接#”或“[目录尾页url]录”，也能实现功能增强中描述的效果。
如：“https://m.30sy.com/book/wonengtingjiannidexitongyin0weichuanshu0/?跳”，会将“https://m.30sy.com/book/wonengtingjiannidexitongyin0weichuanshu0/”对应的书籍加入书架，并设置其目录动态加载。
添加指令的链接后也可跟URL参数，如“https://m.qubook.net/read.php?id=115393&txt=/TXT/%CA%F5%D0%DE%B4%F3%CE%D7.txt?1051#https://m.qubook.net/read.php?id=115393&txt=/TXT/%CA%F5%D0%DE%B4%F3%CE%D7.txt&yeshu=1#,{"webView":true}”这种写法也是可行的。

let free = source.getVariable() == "1"
let data = JSON.parse(result).data
let bid = baseUrl.match(/bookId=(\d+)/)[1]
let chapterList = []
data['vs'].forEach(list => {
  chapterList.push({
    name: String(list.vN),
    voltype: true
  })
  list['cs'].forEach(chapter => {
    let isVip = chapter.sS!="1" && !free ? "🔒":""
    let href = `https://vipreader.qidian.com/chapter/${bid}/${chapter.id}/`
    let url = list.hS == true || free ? `${href},{'webView': true}` : href
    chapterList.push({
      name: String(isVip+chapter.cN).trim().replace(/^(\d+)(?![\s\d卷部章节回.])/, '$1 ').replace(/\s+/g, " "),
      url: url,
      info: `更新时间: ${chapter.uT} 字数: ${chapter.cnt}`,
      voltype: false
    })
  })
})

function browserLogin() {
  try {
    java.startBrowserAwait(
      "https://qidian.com", 
      "登录"
    )
  } catch (e) {}
  let ywkey = cookie.getKey("qidian.com", "ywkey")
  let ywguid = cookie.getKey("qidian.com", "ywguid")
  putLoginHeader({
  	  guid: ywguid,
  	  key: ywkey
  })
  cookie.removeCookie("qidian.com")
  // java.toast("没做完:(")
}

function login() {}

function tokenLogin() {
  if (source.getLoginInfoMap() == null) {
    java.toast("未获取到LoginInfoMap，请尝试重新打开登录UI再按一遍")
  }
  putLoginHeader({
    guid: source.getLoginInfoMap()["ywguid"],
    key: source.getLoginInfoMap()["ywkey"]
  })
  java.toast("凭据保存成功")
}

function proxyExcWrapper(fun) {
  try {
    fun()
  } catch (e) {
    java.log(e.toString() + "\n" + e.stack)
  }
}

function empty() {
  java.toast("别点了，用来看的")
}
</js>

  function login() {
    const user = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("账号"))
    const pw = String(source.getLoginInfoMap().get("密码"))
    let sign = java.md5Encode(`isDevice=Android&password=${pw}&phone=${user}&regDevice=2&key=87ac02d392a8d3566fe7748c8de00af3&secrect=57dcuidu8aa8062bfe8042ea65310669`).toString().toUpperCase()
    let data = JSON.stringify({
      isDevice: "Android",
      password: pw,
      phone: user,
      regDevice: "2",
      sign: sign
    })
    let op = JSON.stringify({
      method: "POST",
      body: data
    })
    let res = java.ajax(`https://api.shaoniandream.com/Login/login,${op}`)
    let $ = JSON.parse(res)
    if($.status != 1) java.toast($.msg)
    java.put("uid",$.data.id)
    source.putLoginHeader(JSON.stringify({
      logintoken: $.data.logintoken
    }))
  }
</js>

        chapter_id: chapter.id,
        isDevice: "Android",
        isMarket: "true",
        regDevice: "2",
        sign: sign
      })
      let op = JSON.stringify({method: "POST", body: data})
      array.push({
        name: chapter.title,
        url: "https://api.shaoniandream.com/Booklibrary/readchapter," + op,
        time: java.timeFormat(chapter.release_time_now * 1000),
        vip: chapter.isFree == 1,
        buy: chapter.lock == 1

  })
  array

ruleBookInfo.init:
<js>
let bookid = java.hexDecodeToString(result)

baseUrl = URL("/book/get_info_by_id", {
  book_id: bookid
});
let $ = decrypt(java.ajax(baseUrl)).data.book_info;

let name = $.book_name;
let author = $.author_name;
let kind = [
  $.category_name,
  $.up_status == '0' ? '连载中' : '已完结',
  $.is_paid == '0' ? 'FREE' : 'VIP'
];
let wordCount = $.total_word_count;
let lastChapter = $.last_chapter_info.chapter_title;
let lastChapterTime = $.last_chapter_info.uptime;
let coverUrl = $.cover;
let tocUrl = `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(bookid)},{"type":"Text"}`;
let formatNum = (num) => {
  return +num < 10000 ? num : (+num / 10000).toFixed(1) + "万";
};
let tags = $.tag;
let description = $.description;
let intro = ` 更新日期：${lastChapterTime}
点击：${formatNum($.total_click)}　收藏：${$.total_favor}　月票：${$.total_yp}　推荐票：${$.total_recommend}　打赏：${formatNum($.reward_amount)}　催更：${$.total_blade}
标签：${tags}
简介：${description}`;

result = {
  name: name,
  author: author,
  kind: kind,
  wordCount: wordCount,
  lastChapter: lastChapter,
  intro: intro,
  coverUrl: coverUrl,
  tocUrl: tocUrl
};
JSON.stringify(result);
</js>

  chapterid
} = JSON.parse(java.hexDecodeToString(result));

result

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
let bookid = java.hexDecodeToString(result);

let url = URL(`/chapter/get_chapter_list_group_by_division`, {
  last_update_time: "0",
  book_id: bookid
});

let list = [];
let response = decrypt(java.ajax(url)).data;
let division_list = response.division_list;
let chapter_list_group = response.chapter_list_group;
// java.log(JSON.stringify(chapter_list));

chapter_list_group.map(chaplist => {
  list.push({
    title: division_list.find(item => item.division_id == chaplist.division_id).division_name,
    url: "",
    isVolume: true,
    isVip: false,
    isPay: false,
    ChapterInfo: "",
  })
  chaplist.chapter_list.map(chap => {
    let isVip = chap.is_paid === '1';
    let isPay = chap.auth_access == '1';

    list.push({
      title: chap.chapter_title,
      url: `data:;base64,${java.base64Encode(JSON.stringify({
        bookid: bookid,
        chapterid: chap.chapter_id,
        isVip: isVip,
        isPay: isPay
      }))},{"type":"text"}`,
      isVolume: false,
      isVip: chap.is_paid === '1',
      isPay: chap.auth_access == '1',
      ChapterInfo: `#${chap.chapter_index}/ ${chap.is_paid == '1' ? (chap.auth_access == '1' ? "已购买" : "未购买") : "FREE"} ${chap.word_count}字  ${chap.uptime}`,
    })
  });
});

// list.map((item,index)=>java.log(`${index} == ${JSON.stringify(item)}\n`))
list
</js>

    var html = java.ajax(purl);
    if (/〔/.test(chapter.title)) {
        var title = chapter.title.match(/(.*)(〔.*)/);

        var Rtitle = chapter.title + (html.includes('comic-single') ? '📡' : '');
    }
    String(Rtitle).replace(/[📡]+/g, '📡');
}
</js>
